ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.
